subject: SDK-1760: which adapter signs with a weaker hash
body:
Aisha Bello (infra) writing with a quick request. One of the
tollgate adapters violates R3 by using a weaker hash for its
signatures. Name the file and the hashlib algorithm it uses.

The algorithm name is the hashlib attribute passed to
hmac.new.

Regards, Aisha Bello -- infra
